title: Nanomaterial-enabled metabolic reprogramming strategies for boosting antitumor immunity
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00679H, Review Article
Muye Ma, Yongliang Zhang, Kanyi Pu, Wei Tang
We discuss the recent advances in nanomaterial design strategies for immunometabolic modulatory platforms and their applications in targeting the cancer-immunity cycle to enhance therapeutic outcomes.
